name: Residue
description: Every seventh cell keeps its full square; the rest are cut back to a diamond.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: @shape(points: 4; rotate: 45; scale: 0.9); clip-path: @shape(points: 4; rotate: 45; scale: 0.9); @match(@i % 7 == 0) { -webkit-clip-path: @shape(points: 4; scale: 0.99); clip-path: @shape(points: 4; scale: 0.99); } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
